name: Théoden
subtitle: Rekindled King
game_text:
While you can spot a <culture>Rohan</culture> Man, Théoden's twilight cost is −1.
<phase>Fellowship</phase>: If the twilight pool has fewer than 2 twilight tokens, play a <culture>Rohan</culture> possession on Théoden and add <twilight>2</twilight> to heal another <culture>Rohan</culture> companion.
